title: Sentiment‑Analysis Projects Collection
description: This repository hosts multiple sentiment analysis projects covering various domains such as e‑commerce reviews, social media posts, and custom text datasets. Each project typically follows a workflow of data collection or scraping, text cleaning and preprocessing, feature extraction (e.g., TF‑IDF or embeddings), model training (machine learning or deep learning), and evaluation/visualisation of sentiment outcomes. The code is written in Python, uses Jupyter notebooks for exploratory work, and demonstrates end‑to‑end handling of text data through to actionable insights.
